stories.title: Four dead and thousands without power after Hurricane Isaias lashes US

en.title: Four dead and thousands without power after Hurricane Isaias lashes US
en.summary: Hurricane Isaias struck the US on Friday evening, causing four deaths and widespread power outages. The storm damaged buildings by ripping off roofs before weakening to a post-tropical cyclone.

stories.title: Man dies after tiger attack at Yorkshire zoo

en.title: Man dies after tiger attack at Yorkshire zoo
en.summary: A man died following an attack by tigers at a wildlife park near Doncaster in Yorkshire. Police believe the man entered an enclosure housing two endangered Amur tigers.

stories.title: Gunman kills 8 people - including pregnant woman and 2 children - in Pennsylvania

en.title: Gunman kills 8 people - including pregnant woman and 2 children - in Pennsylvania
en.summary: A shooting in Pennsylvania resulted in eight deaths, including a pregnant woman and two children.

stories.title: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 15 people including three children

en.title: Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia kills at least 15 people including three children
en.summary: A Russian glide bomb attack on Zaporizhzhia killed at least 15 people, including three children. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky characterized the attack as Russia's response to a US diesel fuel agreement.

stories.title: Trump says Ukraine needs a new leader after diesel deal with Russia

en.title: Trump says Ukraine needs a new leader after diesel deal with Russia
en.summary: Donald Trump stated Ukraine requires new leadership, suggesting President Zelenskyy has failed to end the war. Trump made a diesel purchase agreement with Vladimir Putin and blamed Zelenskyy for high US diesel prices.

stories.title: 'Time for Ukraine to get new president,' says Trump after Zelensky condemns diesel deal

en.title: 'Time for Ukraine to get new president,' says Trump after Zelensky condemns diesel deal
en.summary: Trump called for Ukraine's leadership change after Zelenskyy criticized a diesel deal with Russia, which the Ukrainian leader said would fund Moscow's war effort.

en.summary: The United States reportedly negotiated an agreement with Moscow following multiple requests to Ukraine to cease attacking oil refineries.

en.title: US murderer Christa Pike discharged from hospital 10 days after failed execution
en.summary: A US murderer was released from hospital ten days after surviving two lethal injections during an execution attempt last month.

stories.title: Man dies after jumping into tiger enclosure at Yorkshire zoo

en.title: Man dies after jumping into tiger enclosure at Yorkshire zoo
en.summary: A man died at a Yorkshire zoo after jumping into a tiger enclosure and being attacked by the animal. The zoo was evacuated and closed as a result.

stories.title: Police arrest leader of India’s ‘Cockroach’ movement as protesters take to streets

en.title: Police arrest leader of India's 'Cockroach' movement as protesters take to streets
en.summary: Indian authorities arrested Abhijeet Dipke, leader of the Cockroach movement, by removing him from a flight in New Delhi amid ongoing street protests and a broader government crackdown on demonstrations.

en.title: Riyadh airport suspends operations after missile strike injures dozens
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Riyadh airport halted operations following a missile attack that wounded multiple people, occurring as the kingdom prepares to host major investment conferences.

en.title: Nvidia in talks to acquire US 'open' model start-up Reflection AI
en.summary: Nvidia is negotiating to purchase Reflection AI, a US artificial intelligence start-up, as the Trump administration aims to develop competitive alternatives to low-cost Chinese AI models like DeepSeek.

en.title: US warns Kyiv that strikes on Russia jeopardise intelligence-sharing
en.summary: The United States cautioned Ukraine that military strikes targeting Russia could undermine intelligence cooperation, with Trump suggesting Zelenskyy's replacement and criticizing a diesel agreement with Moscow.

stories.title: India’s central bank tries to shore up rupee as it nears record lows

en.title: India's central bank tries to shore up rupee as it nears record lows
en.summary: India's central bank is taking action to support the rupee as it approaches record low levels. Rising energy costs stemming from geopolitical tensions have pressured the currency of the world's fastest-growing major economy.
